integrity: Self-contained analytical proof and a finite reproducibility checker; numerical samples are stress tests, not proofs of infinite claims. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Almost-sure bounded centered oracle error is required. Equality coefficient is sharp uniformly over eligible radius ratios; no optimal fixed-ratio constants or broad stochastic-convergence theorem are claimed. The subthreshold zero-drift example is acknowledged from Chen et al. 2020.
title: A sharp endpoint alignment law for bounded-noise stochastic gradient clipping
